8 12-11-2024

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned A.P.P. for the State and learned counsel for the O.P. No. 2.
2.
The petitioners apprehend their arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the prosecution case, it is alleged that the petitioners are accused of misappropriating and misusing the loan funds obtained from the Indian Overseas Bank, Kathalwari Branch, Darbhanga.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners are innocent and have been falsely implicated in this case.
The allegation levelled against the petitioners is not Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.13089 of 2024(8) dt.12-11-2024 specific rather general and omnibus in nature.

1 submits that the Bank has already filed a certificate case for the recovery of the said amount vide Certificate Case No. 01/2021-22 (Annexure-P-/3/1 of this application).

sentences.text: Petitioners have no criminal antecedent as mentioned in para-3 of this application.
5. Learned APP for the State as well as learned counsel for the O.P. No. 2 opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

6. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that the Bank has already filed a certificate case for recovery of the said amount, let the above named petitioners, be released on bail, in the event of their arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned lower Court where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with University P.S. Case No.59 of 2021, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) anand/-
